conditions: Male description of the new species (monotypic new genus Paleotoca); holotype male and a female paratype from Cave AP-0038 (a paleoburrow), Caeté, Minas Gerais, Brazil, collected 12 February 2012, deposited IBSP 264705 (type line read through the fetch tool, which returned it in paraphrase). The same absence is printed for the female ('Eye absent.') and for the genus ('Eyes absent'). Methods and any eye-measurement text not opened; no eye diameters reported.

source.authors: Igor Cizauskas, Robson de A. Zampaulo, Antonio D. Brescovit
source.title: A New Genus of Prodidominae Cave Spider from a Paleoburrow and Ferruginous Caves in Brazil (Araneae: Prodidomidae)

where: Section 3.3, male description of Paleotoca diminas
note: new trait: none needed (eyes_count is in check.py). The sentence does not repeat the species name; it sits under the male description of the only species. The Remarks call it 'a troglobitic spider with reduction in cuticular pigments, eye absent, heavy spination and trichobothria' and the Abstract lists 'eye loss'; the Discussion has no eye sentence. Not on main (grep of docs/ for Paleotoca, diminas and taxonomy4030028: no hits). Registry: the World Spider Catalog was not reached (a search found no WSC page for the species; a WSC refincluded page and the Wikipedia Prodidominae list did not list it), so name and family are unchecked and the family is the one the paper prints. Licence: the MDPI page prints 'This article is an open access article distributed under the terms and conditions of the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license' with the creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ link (read in pieces); Crossref licence not queried for this DOI.
